summary: The TotalYearType system provides functionalities to manage various lists related to terms, years, and categories, utilizing the TotalYearData structure to encapsulate code-value pair data.
purpose: Manage term and year data through structured lists, providing easy retrieval and manipulation of temporal and categorical data in the HSPnet system.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Represents the unique identifier or code for a TotalYearData entry.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Represents the descriptive value for a TotalYearData entry.

workflows.name: Get Total Year Data
steps: Create TotalYearData instances for each year or term.
Return the list for use in various parts of the application.

workflows.name: Determine Current and Next Term
steps: Check current date and compare with defined term dates.
Return the current or next term index based on the date.

workflows.name: Get Dates By Term
steps: Calculate start and end dates based on term type.

business_rules: UseAltLanguageFields determines which set of TotalYearData to use.
Dates are parsed and compared based on the current year to determine terms.
conditions: If Today falls between January 1 and April 30, term is Winter.
If Today falls between May 1 and August 31, term is SpringSummer.
If Today falls between September 1 and December 31, term is Fall.
